decisions.reason: As a flagship extension of core vessel-management into offshore and renewable segments, it builds strongly on existing operational know-how and is therefore more likely to be refined than withdrawn.
Crew and corporate travel management is very close to the firm's established support activities, so management can readily absorb market feedback and keep it as a complementary service.

The online vessel information portal is a flagship digital add-on to the firm's existing information and client-service base, and the firm is large enough to improve it through user learning and cooperation if needed.

The mobile vessel performance app is related to core vessel operations but requires more ongoing software and analytics capability than traditional services, so it carries the highest risk but is still more likely to be kept than dropped.
